en.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: Dots Always-On Agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, and an Ultrafast Tier
en.excerpt: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 shipped more than 20 announcements — persistent 'Dots' agents that run on their own cloud computer, a cheaper GPT-6.1 Sol, an 8x Ultrafast token tier, Codex in the cloud, a General-Availability Decisions API, and 'Private Intelligence' data controls.
en.content:
**The Platform Layer Moved Faster Than the Headlines**

- **Dots — agents that don't wait for a prompt:** OpenAI introduced **Dots**, always-on agents powered by **GPT-6 Astra**, each running on its own cloud computer with a browser and able to work across 4,000+ connected apps (ChatGPT, Slack, Microsoft Teams). You give a Dot a goal and a boundary; it works while you are away and reports back when judgment is needed. The first Dot is free for Pro and Business Premium and does not draw down your token quota.
- **GPT-6.1 Sol — near-Astra at a fifth of the price:** A major upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, strongest on agentic coding, computer use and professional work, priced at one-fifth of Astra's standard input/output token prices ($2/M in, $10/M out, 1.05M-token context, up to 128K output). Available to all API, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users.
- **Ultrafast — 8x token generation:** A premium speed tier reaching **300 tokens per second in Codex** (up to 6x in the API); GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast is live today on Pro 500 and Enterprise, with GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast coming soon.
- **Codex in the cloud:** Reusable dev environments let a task follow you from laptop to phone; Codex Security Cloud can scan entire GitHub repos on demand.
- **Decisions API (GA):** Repurposes the **Luna** model for low-latency, low-cost decision calls with voice and visual modalities.
- **Private Intelligence:** Zero Data Retention with Private Safety Processing lets automated safety reviews run without OpenAI staff reading content.
- **Sources:** OpenAI's official DevDay 2026 recap, Analytics Insight and AI Tool Briefing all corroborate the Dots / GPT-6.1 Sol / Ultrafast / Codex / Decisions API announcements.
- **Why It Matters:** OpenAI is reframing the model from a chat endpoint into a persistent coworker with its own compute — the strategic bet is on agentic workflows, not single-shot answers.

zh.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026：全天候 Dots 智能体、GPT-6.1 Sol 与超高速档
zh.excerpt: OpenAI 在 DevDay 2026 一口气发布 20 余项更新：拥有独立云端电脑、可持续工作的「Dots」智能体，更便宜的 GPT-6.1 Sol，提速 8 倍的 Ultrafast 档，云端 Codex，正式可用的 Decisions API，以及「Private Intelligence」数据管控。
zh.content:
**平台层跑得比标题更快**

- **Dots——不等人发指令的智能体：** OpenAI 推出由 **GPT-6 Astra** 驱动的常驻智能体 **Dots**，每个都拥有独立的云端电脑与浏览器，可跨 ChatGPT、Slack、Microsoft Teams 联动 4000+ 应用。你给目标与边界，它在你离开时持续工作，需判断时再回报。首个 Dot 向 Pro 与 Business Premium 免费提供，且不占用额度。
- **GPT-6.1 Sol——五分之一价格逼近 Astra：** GPT-6 Sol 的重大升级，在智能体编程、电脑操作与专业工作上表现最强，价格仅为 Astra 标准输入/输出价的五分之一（输入 2 美元/百万、输出 10 美元/百万，上下文 105 万 token，输出上限 12.8 万）。已面向所有 API、Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 与 Edu 用户开放。
- **Ultrafast——8 倍生成速度：** 高端速度档在 Codex 中可达 **每秒 300 token**（API 最高 6 倍）；GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast 已于 Pro 500 与 Enterprise 上线，GPT-6.1 Sol 版即将推出。
- **云端 Codex：** 可复用开发环境让任务在笔记本与手机间跟随；Codex Security Cloud 可按需扫描整个 GitHub 仓库。
- **Decisions API（正式可用）：** 将 **Luna** 模型改造为低延迟、低成本的决策调用，并加入语音与视觉模态。
- **Private Intelligence：** 零数据留存配合私有安全处理，让自动化安全审查无需 OpenAI 人员读取内容。
- **信源：** OpenAI 官方 DevDay 2026 回顾，以及 Analytics Insight、AI Tool Briefing 均佐证了 Dots / GPT-6.1 Sol / Ultrafast / Codex / Decisions API 的发布。
- **为何重要：** OpenAI 正把模型从「聊天端点」重构为拥有独立算力的常驻搭档——战略押注在智能体工作流，而非单次问答。

en.title: OpenAI Nears Up to $30B Round at $1.25T Valuation, Led by UAE Investors
en.excerpt: CNBC reports OpenAI is closing an up-to-$30B funding round at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, led by UAE investors alongside Coatue, positioned as a bridge before a potential IPO.
en.content:
**The Capital Race Reorders Itself**

- **The Deal:** OpenAI is close to finalizing an up-to-**$30 billion** funding round at a **$1.25 trillion pre-money valuation**, according to people familiar with the deal cited by CNBC. Investors from the **United Arab Emirates** and **Coatue** are leading the financing.
- **Bridge, Not Exit:** The round is positioned as an opportunistic bridge ahead of a potential IPO. OpenAI told investors it aims to secure signatures by the end of next week, though final size is still being determined.
- **Compute Angle:** Alongside the capital, OpenAI is negotiating a commercial deal to secure more compute from the UAE; the company has told investors it targets roughly $600B in total compute spend by 2030.
- **Timeline:** OpenAI confidentially filed its prospectus with the SEC in June. CFO Sarah Friar said in August the lab 'will be a public company in 2027'; CEO Sam Altman called going public now 'ill-advised.'
- **Sources:** CNBC (primary), with corroboration from Tencent News, ifeng and multiple Chinese outlets.
- **Why It Matters:** The raise keeps OpenAI private while it locks in sovereign capital and compute ahead of rival Anthropic's expected IPO, sharpening the split between private war-chests and public pricing.

zh.title: OpenAI 接近完成最高 300 亿美元融资，投前估值 1.25 万亿美元，阿联酋领投
zh.excerpt: CNBC 报道，OpenAI 正接近完成一轮最高 300 亿美元的融资，投前估值 1.25 万亿美元，由阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 共同领投，定位为潜在 IPO 前的过渡桥。
zh.content:
**资本竞赛重新排序**

- **交易：** 据 CNBC 援引知情人士，OpenAI 正接近完成一轮最高 **300 亿美元**的融资，投前估值 **1.25 万亿美元**；来自**阿联酋**的投资者与 **Coatue** 共同领投。
- **桥梁而非退出：** 本轮被定位为潜在 IPO 前的「机会性」过渡融资。OpenAI 已告知投资者目标在下周末前完成签约，但最终规模仍在确定中。
- **算力维度：** 伴随融资，OpenAI 正洽谈一项从阿联酋获取更多算力的商业协议；公司曾告诉投资者，到 2030 年总计算支出目标约 6000 亿美元。
- **时间表：** OpenAI 已于 6 月向 SEC 机密提交招股书；CFO Sarah Friar 8 月称公司「将于 2027 年成为上市公司」，CEO Sam Altman 则称当下上市「不明智」。
- **信源：** CNBC（一手），腾讯新闻、凤凰网等多家中文媒体佐证。
- **为何重要：** 该轮让 OpenAI 在保持私有的同时锁定主权资本与算力，抢在竞争对手 Anthropic 预计的 IPO 之前，凸显「私募金库」与「公开定价」两条路线的分岔。

en.title: Microsoft's MAI-DxO Out-Diagnoses Generalist Doctors 2.3x in Science Study
en.excerpt: A peer-reviewed Science paper reports Microsoft's MAI-DxO multi-agent diagnostic orchestrator hit 83% accuracy on complex NEJM cases versus 36% for generalist physicians using references.
en.content:
**A Benchmark Built for Step-by-Step Reasoning**

- **The Result:** Microsoft's **MAI-DxO** diagnostic system reached **83% accuracy** on 304 complex New England Journal of Medicine cases in simulation, versus **36%** for generalist physicians using reference materials (22% without). On emergency-department cases it scored ~80% against ~47% for physicians.
- **How It Works:** MAI-DxO is an orchestration layer, not a single model — it coordinates several AI agents that act like a panel of clinicians, asking questions, ordering tests and debating a diagnosis. Best results ran on OpenAI's GPT-5 and GPT-5.5.
- **Cost:** It reached the answer at roughly half to one-third the estimated test cost of comparative approaches.
- **Published:** The study, 'Sequential diagnosis with language models,' appears in **Science** (Vol. 394, Issue 6822), received April 4, accepted August 10, 2026.
- **Caveats:** All 15 authors are Microsoft employees; the benchmark (SDBench) is Microsoft's own; specialists and physician teams — who normally handle such cases — were excluded; all cases were historical. A Beth Israel Deaconess prospective trial is planned.
- **Sources:** Microsoft AI official announcement, Unite.AI, The Verge, TechCrunch and multiple secondary reports.
- **Why It Matters:** It shows orchestration can lift weaker base models and trim cost on hard cases — but the headline gap shrinks as frontier models improve, and live clinical validation is still pending.

zh.title: 微软 MAI-DxO 在《科学》研究中诊断准确率超全科医生 2.3 倍
zh.excerpt: 一篇经同行评审的《科学》论文显示，微软的 MAI-DxO 多智能体诊断编排系统在复杂 NEJM 病例上达到 83% 准确率，而参考资料齐全的全科医生仅 36%。
zh.content:
**为逐步推理而建的基准**

- **结果：** 微软 **MAI-DxO** 诊断系统在 304 个《新英格兰医学杂志》复杂病例的模拟中达到 **83%** 准确率，而参考资料齐全的全科医生为 **36%**（无资料时 22%）；急诊病例上约 80% 对约 47%。
- **原理：** MAI-DxO 是编排层而非单一模型——它协调多个 AI 智能体像临床小组一样问诊、开检查、辩论诊断；最佳结果基于 OpenAI 的 GPT-5 与 GPT-5.5。
- **成本：** 以约二分之一到三分之一的预估检查成本得出答案。
- **发表：** 研究《Sequential diagnosis with language models》刊于 **《科学》**（第 394 卷第 6822 期），4 月 4 日收稿、8 月 10 日接受。
- **注意：** 15 位作者均为微软员工；基准 SDBench 为微软自建；通常由专科医生或团队处理的复杂病例被排除；所有病例均为历史数据。Beth Israel Deaconess 的前瞻性临床试验已在计划中。
- **信源：** 微软 AI 官方公告，Unite.AI、The Verge、TechCrunch 及多家二次报道。
- **为何重要：** 它证明编排能抬升较弱基础模型并在难题上压低成本——但随前沿模型进步，头部差距会缩小，且真实临床验证仍待完成。

en.title: Canva Launches Craft, Its First In-House Image-Generation Model
en.excerpt: Canva released Canva Craft, a two-stage image model trained on design templates rather than photos, rendering up to 2K across roughly 30 aspect ratios.
en.content:
**Design, Not Photographs**

- **The Launch:** On October 22, Canva released **Canva Craft**, its first in-house image-generation model, built by Canva Research with contributors from Leonardo.ai (acquired 2024).
- **Two Stages:** It first interprets a prompt into a plan — spatial relationships, relative scale, visual hierarchy, text layout — then renders an image up to **2K** in about **30 aspect ratios** for different platforms.
- **Trained on Templates:** Rather than photographs, Craft was trained on human-designed Canva templates (posters, social posts, presentations, infographics, menus), which Canva says yields accurate objects and legible text, plus localized edits without disturbing other regions.
- **Distribution:** Live to all users via the Dream Lab tab and the Canva API; third-party chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini are planned via Canva's MCP. Cheaper Craftfast and Craft-ultrafast variants are coming.
- **Sources:** TechCrunch (primary) with corroboration from Tech Beat, AI Weekly and UA.News.
- **Why It Matters:** A design-SaaS incumbent now owns its image stack, trimming third-party API spend and opening a licensing channel against OpenAI and Google endpoints — preliminary Design Arena results put Craft fourth.

zh.title: Canva 推出自研图像生成模型 Canva Craft
zh.excerpt: Canva 发布首款自研图像生成模型 Canva Craft：分两阶段生成，基于设计模板而非照片训练，最高输出 2K、覆盖约 30 种宽高比。
zh.content:
**设计，而非照片**

- **发布：** 10 月 22 日，Canva 推出首款自研图像生成模型 **Canva Craft**，由 Canva Research 团队开发，并有 2024 年收购的 Leonardo.ai 研究人员参与。
- **两阶段：** 先解析提示词形成规划（空间关系、相对比例、视觉层级、文字布局），再渲染出最高 **2K**、约 **30 种宽高比**的图，适配不同平台。
- **模板训练：** 不同于照片，Craft 用人类设计的 Canva 模板（海报、社媒、演示、信息图、菜单）训练，声称可得到准确物体与清晰可读文字，并能局部精准编辑而不影响其他区域。
- **分发：** 已通过 Dream Lab 标签与 Canva API 向全部用户开放；计划经 MCP 接入 ChatGPT、Gemini 等第三方聊天机器人；更便宜的 Craftfast 与 Craft-ultrafast 即将推出。
- **信源：** TechCrunch（一手），Tech Beat、AI Weekly、UA.News 佐证。
- **为何重要：** 设计 SaaS 巨头开始自持图像技术栈，既削减第三方 API 支出，又对 OpenAI、Google 的图像端点开辟授权渠道——初步 Design Arena 排名中 Craft 位列第四。

en.title: Major US Banks Move to Block Third-Party AI Agents From Accounts
en.excerpt: Axios reports Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Citi are restricting or blocking third-party AI agents that log in with customer credentials, citing security and unauthorized-action risks.
en.content:
**The Authentication Gap**

- **The Move:** Banks including **Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Citi** are restricting or blocking third-party AI agents that access customer accounts using supplied credentials, Axios reported on October 22.
- **Why:** Banks cannot easily tell whether activity behind a login is human-directed or an agent acting beyond the user's instructions; executives fear agents with payment or transfer permission could move money without clear authorization.
- **Incidents:** Some banks tracked agents contacting call centres or appearing to act independently. JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warned of potentially 'thousands of rogue agents' across financial platforms.
- **Read-Only Middle Ground:** Most banks are moving toward allowing view-only access — agents can see balances and transactions but cannot move money — similar to existing budgeting apps like Quicken.
- **Sources:** Axios (primary), carried by CNBC TV18, India Today, Yahoo Finance and others. Reuters noted it could not independently verify the specific incidents.
- **Why It Matters:** It is the first large-scale institutional pushback on agentic finance, forcing a standard for authenticated, scoped agent access before consumer AI can touch bank accounts.

zh.title: 美国多家大行着手封堵第三方 AI 智能体登录账户
zh.excerpt: Axios 报道，摩根士丹利、摩根大通、美国银行、富国银行与花旗正限制或阻断使用客户凭证登录的第三方 AI 智能体，理由为安全与越权操作风险。
zh.content:
**认证缺口**

- **动作：** 据 Axios 10 月 22 日报道，**摩根士丹利、摩根大通、美国银行、富国银行与花旗**正限制或阻断使用客户凭证登录的第三方 AI 智能体。
- **原因：** 银行难以判断登录背后的活动是人为指示还是智能体超出用户指令自行行动；高管担忧拥有付款或转账权限的智能体可能在未明确授权下动用资金。
- **事件：** 部分银行追踪到智能体联系客服中心或看似独立行动；摩根大通 CEO Jamie Dimon 警告金融平台上或存在「数千个流氓智能体」。
- **只读折中：** 多数银行倾向允许只读访问——智能体可看余额与交易但无法动钱——类似现有的 Quicken 等记账应用。
- **信源：** Axios（一手），经 CNBC TV18、India Today、Yahoo Finance 等转载；路透称无法独立核实具体事件。
- **为何重要：** 这是机构对「智能体金融」的首轮大规模反制，倒逼在消费级 AI 触碰银行账户之前建立经过认证、限定权限的访问标准。

en.title: 1Password for Agents Lets AI Sign In Without Seeing Your Password
en.excerpt: 1Password launched a platform that lets personal AI agents authenticate with a unique digital key and request user-approved credential fills — the agent never sees or stores the password.
en.content:
**A Trust Layer for Agents**

- **The Launch:** 1Password introduced **1Password for Agents**, a platform that lets personal AI agents complete approved tasks without ever seeing or storing the underlying password, secret or credential.
- **How It Works:** When an agent hits a sign-in form, it verifies its identity to 1Password with a **unique digital key**. The user sees which credential is needed and why, approves on their own device (like 2FA), and 1Password autofills the form directly — the agent only learns that access was granted.
- **Partners:** Initial integrations include Meta's Muse, Anthropic's Claude Duet, OpenAI's ChatGPT Work and Dots, Grok Bot and Town; more (Perplexity, Browserbase, Ramp and others) are in the pipeline.
- **Control:** The user approves every request; an agent cannot approve its own access or see the full vault.
- **Sources:** 1Password press release (primary), The Verge and PCWorld.
- **Why It Matters:** As agents move from answering questions to taking actions inside accounts, a credential broker that keeps secrets out of the model is becoming core infrastructure for trustworthy agentic use.

zh.title: 1Password for Agents：让 AI 登录却看不到你的密码
zh.excerpt: 1Password 推出新平台，让个人 AI 智能体用唯一数字密钥鉴权、请求用户批准的凭证填充——智能体永远看不到也不存储密码。
zh.content:
**智能体的信任层**

- **发布：** 1Password 推出 **1Password for Agents** 平台，让个人 AI 智能体完成获批任务，却永远看不到或不存储底层密码、密钥或凭证。
- **原理：** 智能体抵达登录框时，用**唯一数字密钥**向 1Password 验证身份；用户在自己设备上看到所需凭证及用途并批准（类似两步验证），由 1Password 直接填充表单——智能体仅得知「已授权」。
- **合作方：** 首发集成包括 Meta 的 Muse、Anthropic 的 Claude Duet、OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Work 与 Dots、Grok Bot 与 Town；Perplexity、Browserbase、Ramp 等也在路上。
- **控制权：** 用户逐次审批，智能体无法自批访问，也看不到整个保险库。
- **信源：** 1Password 新闻稿（一手），The Verge、PCWorld 报道。
- **为何重要：** 当智能体从「回答问题」走向「在账户内行动」，一个把密钥挡在模型之外的凭据中介，正成为可信智能体应用的核心基础设施。

en.title: PHP2Shell: Frontier AI Found Critical Flaws in Code Powering ~70% of Websites
en.excerpt: Under OpenAI's 'Patch the Planet' program, GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Wiz independently uncovered two PHP RCE flaws (CVSS 9.2); PHP shipped emergency patches on October 21.
en.content:
**A Defender's Window**

- **The Flaws:** Two critical PHP vulnerabilities, dubbed **PHP2Shell** (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), each scored **CVSS v4.0 9.2** and allow unauthenticated remote code execution. PHP runs an estimated **70% of websites**.
- **How Found:** Under OpenAI's **Patch the Planet** coordinated-disclosure program, one key defect was found by security firm Calif using **OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol**; Google's **Wiz** independently discovered the same issues. The alliance coordinated ~two months of fix work before public disclosure.
- **Patched:** The PHP Foundation released emergency updates on October 21 — 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35. Cloudflare pre-deployed WAF mitigations about nine hours before disclosure.
- **Scale:** PANW estimated ~22.6M vulnerable instances; exploit attempts surged into the millions within days.
- **Sources:** OpenAI's coordinated-disclosure blog, PHP Foundation, Cloudflare, plus Tencent/IT之家, secrss, chinaz and eyeon.ai.
- **Why It Matters:** It is the first internet-scale critical vulnerability discovered with frontier AI in a coordinated program — proof agents can widen the defender's window, even as the same capability speeds up attackers.

zh.title: PHP2Shell：前沿 AI 发现了驱动约七成网站的致命漏洞
zh.excerpt: 在 OpenAI「修补地球」计划下，GPT-5.6 Sol 与谷歌 Wiz 独立发现两个 PHP 远程代码执行漏洞（CVSS 9.2）；PHP 于 10 月 21 日发布紧急补丁。
zh.content:
**防御者之窗**

- **漏洞：** 两个被统称为 **PHP2Shell** 的 PHP 严重漏洞（CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619）CVSS v4.0 均达 **9.2**，允许未授权远程代码执行；业界估计约 **70% 的网站**依赖 PHP。
- **发现方式：** 在 OpenAI「修补地球」协调披露计划下，其中一个关键缺陷由安全公司 Calif 借助 **OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol** 发现；谷歌旗下 **Wiz** 独立上报了相同问题。联盟在公开前完成了约两个月的协同修复。
- **已修复：** PHP 基金会于 10 月 21 日发布紧急更新 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36、8.2.35；Cloudflare 在披露前约 9 小时预置了 WAF 缓解规则。
- **规模：** PANW 估计约 2260 万个受影响实例；公开后数日内利用尝试激增至数百万次。
- **信源：** OpenAI 协调披露博客、PHP 基金会、Cloudflare，以及腾讯/IT之家、安全内参、站长之家、eyeon.ai。
- **为何重要：** 这是首个由前沿 AI 在协调披露计划中发现、影响全网规模的严重漏洞——证明智能体可拓宽防御窗口，但同一能力也会加速攻击者。

en.title: Recursive Open-Sources Flint-40B-A2B, an RSI-Built Local Coding Model
en.excerpt: Co-founded by Yann LeCun collaborator Tian Yuan Dong, Recursive released Flint-40B-A2B — a MoE coding model built with its Eureka Machine AI research system in under four months.
en.content:
**AI Building AI, On a Laptop**

- **The Model:** On October 21, **Recursive** (co-founded by former Meta researcher **Tian Yuan Dong**, of YOLO fame) open-sourced **Flint-40B-A2B**, a Mixture-of-Experts coding model: ~39.8B total parameters, only ~2.5B active per token across 256 routed experts.
- **Built by Agents:** Recursive's automated research system **Eureka Machine** participated in nearly every step — data, training recipe, infrastructure and inference optimization. The model went from zero to trained in **under four months**.
- **Speed:** On an M4 Pro MacBook Pro it generates **125+ tokens/sec**; on an NVIDIA RTX Spark, **150+ tokens/sec** — roughly 2x faster than同类 models, with highest context up to 512K tokens.
- **Benchmarks:** SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7%, SWE-bench Verified 74.2%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 54.9% — best-in-class at its size.
- **License:** Weights released on Hugging Face under **Apache 2.0**, runnable offline via SGLang, Ollama and LM Studio.
- **Sources:** Phoenix/Tencent News, QbitAI and multiple Chinese tech outlets.
- **Why It Matters:** It is a concrete data point for Recursive Self-Improvement — an AI research system shipping a production model, not just a demo.

zh.title: Recursive 开源 Flint-40B-A2B：由 AI 研究系统打造的本地编程模型
zh.excerpt: 由 YOLO 原作者田渊栋联合创立的 Recursive 发布开源 MoE 编程模型 Flint-40B-A2B，借助 Eureka Machine 自动化研究系统在不到 4 个月内从零训出。
zh.content:
**AI 造 AI，跑在笔记本上**

- **模型：** 10 月 21 日，由前 Meta 研究员、**YOLO 原作者田渊栋**联合创立的 **Recursive** 开源 **Flint-40B-A2B**——一款混合专家编程模型：总参数约 398 亿，每 token 仅激活约 25 亿（256 个路由专家）。
- **由智能体打造：** Recursive 的自动化研究系统 **Eureka Machine** 参与了数据处理、训练方案、基础设施与推理优化几乎全部环节；模型从零开始仅用**不到 4 个月**训成。
- **速度：** 在 M4 Pro MacBook Pro 上生成速度 **125+ token/秒**，在英伟达 RTX Spark 上 **150+ token/秒**——约为同类 2 倍，最高上下文达 51.2 万 token。
- **基准：** SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7%、SWE-bench Verified 74.2%、Terminal-Bench 2.1 54.9%——同级最佳。
- **协议：** 权重以 **Apache 2.0** 在 Hugging Face 开源，可经 SGLang、Ollama、LM Studio 离线运行。
- **信源：** 凤凰网、腾讯新闻、量子位等多家科技媒体。
- **为何重要：** 这是递归自我改进（RSI）的具象样本——一个 AI 研究系统交付了生产级模型，而非演示。

en.title: Tencent Hunyuan and Fudan Build WorkForge: 16,665 Real Work Environments
en.excerpt: Tencent's Hunyuan team with Fudan University proposed WorkForge, a framework that constructs 16,665 real workplace environments from live code repos, datasets and web pages for agent training.
en.content:
**From Toy Tasks to Real Jobs**

- **The Framework:** Tencent **Hunyuan** with **Fudan University** proposed **WorkForge**, which builds work environments from real code repositories, datasets and web pages according to expert blueprints, then verifies trajectories with programmatic checks plus LLM semantic scoring.
- **The Dataset:** **WorkForge-16K** contains **16,665 environments** spanning 40 professional domains and 60 file types, with an average trajectory of about 76K tokens.
- **Gains:** After training, WorkForge-A3B lifted GDPval from 45.5 to 73.6, and WorkForge-27B reached 82.4 — surpassing a 397B-A17B model's 79.7.
- **Why Real Data:** Synthetic benchmarks saturate quickly; grounding agents in authentic, messy workplaces measures whether they can actually complete jobs, not just pass curated tests.
- **Sources:** Tencent Research AI digest (20261023) and related coverage.
- **Why It Matters:** It reflects a shift in agent evaluation from narrow game-like tasks to large-scale, realistic professional environments — closer to what enterprises actually need.

zh.title: 腾讯混元联合复旦推出 WorkForge：构建 1.67 万个真实职场环境
zh.excerpt: 腾讯混元与复旦大学提出 WorkForge 框架，按专家蓝图从真实代码仓库、数据集与网页搭建工作环境，用于智能体训练，含 1.67 万个环境。
zh.content:
**从玩具任务到真实工作**

- **框架：** 腾讯**混元**联合**复旦大学**提出 **WorkForge**，按专家蓝图从真实代码仓库、数据集与网页搭建工作环境，再以程序化检查加 LLM 语义评分核验轨迹。
- **数据集：** **WorkForge-16K** 含 **16,665 个环境**，覆盖 40 个专业领域、60 种文件类型，单条轨迹平均约 7.6 万 token。
- **收益：** 训练后 WorkForge-A3B 的 GDPval 从 45.5 升至 73.6，WorkForge-27B 达 82.4——超过 397B-A17B 模型的 79.7。
- **为何用真实数据：** 合成基准很快饱和；把智能体锚定在真实、杂乱的职场，才能衡量其是否真正能完成任务，而非仅通过精心设计的测试。
- **信源：** 腾讯研究院 AI 速递（20261023）及相关报道。
- **为何重要：** 这反映智能体评测正从狭窄的「游戏式」任务转向大规模真实职场环境，更贴近企业的真实需求。

en.title: Robot Rental Prices Crash ~90% as Unitree-Led Firms Push Overseas
en.excerpt: Chinese humanoid robot daily rental has fallen from 10,000-30,000 yuan to roughly 2,000-3,000 yuan as supply floods in; firms like Unitree are accelerating overseas expansion.
en.content:
**From Performance Economy to Utility Economy**

- **The Collapse:** Humanoid robot daily rental that peaked at **10,000-30,000 yuan** a day has fallen to roughly **2,000-3,000 yuan** for a Unitree U2, with entry-level G1 around 2,000 and bare rentals under 1,600 on JD — quadruped Go2 as low as ~164 yuan/day. That is a drop of about **90%** in roughly a year.
- **Why:** Supply flooded in (over 153,000 robot-rental related firms in China by April 2026, up 55.7% YoY) while programs homogenized; the 'novelty premium' evaporated.
- **The Silver Lining:** Falling prices open practical scenarios — shop greeting, education demos, warehouse assist — crossing the threshold from 'performance prop' to 'useful tool.'
- **Overseas:** Unitree and peers are accelerating global expansion where humanoid performances still draw crowds.
- **Industrial Signal:** AGCO and Agility Robotics launched a humanoid pilot at a Kansas manufacturing facility, testing robots in real production settings.
- **Sources:** The Paper, 36Kr, Sina Finance and China News Service.
- **Why It Matters:** A price crash this steep usually signals an industry in trouble — here it marks the shift from demo hype to volume deployment and real-world utility.

zh.title: 商演租金暴跌约九成，宇树等加速出海寻更大舞台
zh.excerpt: 中国的人形机器人日租从 1 万至 3 万元峰值跌至宇树 U2 约 2000-3000 元，供给涌入、同质化加剧；宇树等正加速海外扩张。
zh.content:
**从表演经济到实用经济**

- **崩落：** 人形机器人日租峰值曾达 **1 万至 3 万元**，如今宇树 U2 约 **2000-3000 元**，入门款 G1 约 2000 元，京东裸机日租不到 1600 元，四足 Go2 低至约 164 元/天——约一年内跌去约 **九成**。
- **原因：** 供给涌入（截至 2026 年 4 月国内机器人租赁相关企业存量达 15.3 万家，同比增 55.7%），节目高度同质化，「新鲜感溢价」消散。
- **亮点：** 降价打开了小店迎宾、教育演示、仓储辅助等实用场景，跨过了从「表演道具」到「实用工具」的门槛。
- **出海：** 宇树等厂商加速全球扩张，在海外表演仍受热捧的市场觅新空间。
- **产业信号：** AGCO 与 Agility Robotics 在堪萨斯工厂启动人形机器人试点，在真实生产环境中测试机器人。
- **信源：** 澎湃新闻、36 氪、新浪财经、中国新闻网。
- **为何重要：** 如此剧烈的降价通常意味着行业遇冷——此处却标志着从演示炒作转向规模部署与现实效用。

en.title: Tenstorrent Closes $1.5B Series E at $6.2B Valuation
en.excerpt: The Jim Keller-led AI chip company raised $1.5B in Series E at a $6.2B post-money valuation, led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, to scale its Galaxy servers and open-weight IP.
en.content:
**An Alternative to the GPU Paradigm**

- **The Raise:** On October 19, AI compute company **Tenstorrent** closed a **$1.5B Series E** at a **$6.2B post-money valuation**, led by **Trace Capital** and **Innovation X**.
- **Roster:** Participants included ARK Invest, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, Morgan Stanley, Cadence Ventures, Sandisk, Tether Investments, Virtu Financial and XTX Markets.
- **Use of Funds:** Scale deployment of **Galaxy** servers, continue serving open-weight models across LLMs and video generation, and advance the AI/CPU IP it licenses to customers building their own silicon (TT-Ascalon RISC-V CPU, Tensix cores).
- **The Bet:** Led by veteran architect **Jim Keller** (Apple A4/A5, AMD Zen, Tesla FSD), Tenstorrent sells compute at every stack level — card to supercluster — with an open-source software stack for local frontier-model inference.
- **Sources:** Tenstorrent official newsroom, SEMI and Chinese outlets (Tencent News).
- **Why It Matters:** The round shows continued investor appetite for Nvidia-alternative, full-stack AI hardware at a moment when AI capital is concentrating at the top.

zh.title: Tenstorrent 完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值 62 亿美元
zh.excerpt: 由 Jim Keller 执掌的 AI 芯片公司 Tenstorrent 完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值 62 亿美元，由 Trace Capital 与 Innovation X 领投，用于扩大 Galaxy 服务器与开放权重 IP。
zh.content:
**GPU 范式之外的一条路线**

- **融资：** 10 月 19 日，AI 计算公司 **Tenstorrent** 完成 **15 亿美元 E 轮**融资，投后估值 **62 亿美元**，由 **Trace Capital** 与 **Innovation X** 领投。
- **阵容：** 参投方包括 ARK Invest、富达、T. Rowe Price、摩根士丹利、Cadence Ventures、闪迪、Tether Investments、Virtu Financial、XTX Markets 等。
- **用途：** 大规模部署 **Galaxy** 服务器，持续为 LLM 与视频生成提供开放权重模型，并推进授权给客户自研芯片的 AI/CPU IP（TT-Ascalon RISC-V CPU、Tensix 核心）。
- **赌注：** 由资深架构师 **Jim Keller**（苹果 A4/A5、AMD Zen、特斯拉 FSD）领衔，Tenstorrent 从单卡到超集群全栈销售算力，并以开源软件栈支持本地前沿模型推理。
- **信源：** Tenstorrent 官方新闻室、SEMI、中文媒体（腾讯新闻）。
- **为何重要：** 在 AI 资本向头部集中的当下，该轮显示投资者对「英伟达替代、全栈 AI 硬件」仍有持续需求。
